text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To Cheval Grand, who had safely finished 
running, I sent a loud cheer—
choice_data_list: Cheval!! Well done, you were amazing!
Cheval!! Well done, you did great!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Are these... cheers...? The ground is 
shaking—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I knew it... The Derby is incredible... 
I've never heard... a wall of sound like 
this...)
—Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Miss Crown...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...That was a good Derby. I wonder if it's 
thanks to all the training we did 
together.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: N... no way. That couldn't be...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course that's not true, right? You gave 
it your all every day up until now—that in 
itself is meaningful.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't you think so too, 
Duramente-san?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
There is no good or bad in a race you 
lose. If it is not a victory, it is 
'meaningless.'

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“Mmh, as hard on yourself as always... 
Knowing you though, you're going to give 
it your all again, aren't you...?”

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Of course.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
First, I must prove that I am the 
"strongest" in the country.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why... the next is the 
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
In the final race of the Classic Triple 
Crown, I will seize the title of the 
"strongest" without fail. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur... murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente's Fan
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, did you hear that? She just said 
the Kikuka Sho... Does that mean she gave 
up on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...... Allow me to declare it once more.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"To prove my bloodline, I will demonstrate 
what it means to be the 'strongest'――"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
First, the domestic scene. In the upcoming 
Kikuka Sho, I will definitely seize 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
And after that, the world. That is where—I 
will fulfill my long-cherished 
ambition...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! Duramente's surprisingly flashy with 
what she does, isn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Though what I want to say might be the 
same— I can't afford to lose next time 
either.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I will win without fail. On the prestige 
of Satono, and on my pride—!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Well then—see you later, Cheval. Let's run 
together again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While waiting in the underground tunnel 
for Cheval Grand, who finished the race 
safely, the Umamusume who returned earlier 
come into view—

text_block_list.name: Race Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to win... I wanted to win...! 
Aaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Race Participant Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"No... There's no way it ends like this... 
I don't... I don't want to believe it...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Among them, there must be Umamusume for 
whom the Derby was their lifelong dream. 
As my heart ached hearing their anguished 
cries—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand returned with slumped 
shoulders. As expected, she too must be 
devastated by the defeat.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ……! No, that's not it, I……!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
C-Crown-san told me earlier... that doing 
everything in my power is what truly 
matters.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I thought... I was trying my best in my 
own way too. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...That was a good Derby. I wonder if it's 
thanks to all the training we did 
together.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: N... no way. That couldn't be...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course that's not true, right? You gave 
it your all every day up until now—that in 
itself is meaningful.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't... I just couldn't bring myself 
to say that I gave it my all, that I left 
nothing on the track...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm not even crying or angry over 
the frustration... Even though I lost, 
part of me has just accepted it...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I'm so embarrassed...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If you don't bet everything and give it 
your all, you shouldn't even have the 
right to feel frustrated...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
What frustrates me the most is that I 
can't even feel properly frustrated...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Cheval Grand so downcast, I didn't 
know what else to say to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her physical growth is progressing 
steadily. However, her heart remains 
shrunken and lacking in confidence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, leaving major challenges 
unresolved, Cheval Grand's Japanese Derby 
came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unlike the body, changes of the heart take 
a long time. Walking that journey together 
with her— I reflected that this was all I 
could do.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It's all over... The Derby is...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I was able to run at full power... But 
still...
